mapper.sql: SELECT p.COMPANY_ID, p.ACCOUNT_NO, p.AREA, p.CURRENCY, p.ACCOUNT_TYPE, a.ALIAS FROM COMPANY_ACCOUNT p LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_ALIAS a ON a.COMPANY_ID = p.COMPANY_ID AND a.ACCOUNT_NO = p.ACCOUNT_NO
mapper.select: WHERE p.COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} ORDER BY p.AREA, p.ACCOUNT_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE ACCOUNT_ALIAS SET ALIAS = #{alias} WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_ALIAS (COMPANY_ID, ACCOUNT_NO, ALIAS) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{accountNo}, #{alias})
